title: AssuranceProfile
description: The domain-specific policy the domain-general control plane is parameterized by (spec §6.5 / §16). Binds, for one task domain + risk class: the criteria and their severity/mandatoriness, the criterion->verifier registry, the enforcement policy (when a reviewer is required, and the TERMINAL action for every failure mode — unknown-on-critical, reviewer timeout, schema error, no-reviewer, evidence-budget exhaustion, conflict), the review/evidence round budgets (bounded-loop invariant §5.6), the calibrated reviewer-risk threshold that gates blocking authority (§8 step 5 / §11.4), and the calibration cohort. §10.2 is load-bearing: NO profile may leave the evidence-budget terminal action unspecified. Immutable + content-addressed; a change invalidates prior decisions taken under it (§12.3).

profile_id.description: Stable id, e.g. 'swe_release:v3'. Part of the rubric cache key (§15.3) and the DecisionEnvelope governance hash.

domain.description: Task domain (spec §16). The transport/schemas/ledger/reducer are domain-general; evidence semantics + tolerances are not.

risk_class.description: Overall risk class of tasks under this profile — governs how conservative the fail-open/fail-closed policy must be.

criteria.description: Map of criterion_id -> {severity, mandatory}. Criterion_ids key VerificationReport.checks[].criterion_id, EvidenceItem.criterion_id, and ReviewDecision finding.criterion_id.

mandatory.description: A mandatory criterion must be conclusively satisfied for auto-approval; an unresolved mandatory critical criterion cannot be auto-approved absent an explicit bounded fail-open policy (§7.3 rule 6).

verifier_registry.description: Map of criterion_id -> ordered list of verifier ids that can produce evidence for it (spec §6.5). Its content hash is a DecisionEnvelope governance input; a verifier version change invalidates prior decisions (§12.3).

policy.description: Enforcement policy. Every failure mode has a TERMINAL action so no state can create an unbounded loop (§5.6) and no profile leaves the evidence-budget terminal unspecified (§10.2).

reviewer_required_at.description: Gates at which the heavyweight reviewer is invoked (spec §4.2/§23.2). Empty = fast-path only.

unknown_on_critical.description: Action when a critical criterion is logically unknown (spec §6.5).

reviewer_timeout.description: Action when the reviewer times out (spec §6.5/§9.3).

schema_error.description: Action when reviewer output fails schema validation after the one bounded correction attempt (§9.3 terminal ABSTAIN_SCHEMA_ERROR).

no_reviewer_available.description: Action when no reviewer backend is available (spec §6.5).

conflict.description: Action on conflicting authoritative evidence (§7.3 rule 4 — must not silently auto-approve; default escalate).

evidence_budget_exhausted.description: REQUIRED terminal action when the REQUEST_EVIDENCE budget is exhausted (spec §10.2 — no profile may leave this unspecified). fail_open permitted only for explicitly low-risk profiles.

max_review_rounds.description: Bounded-loop budget: max reviewer rounds per decision (§5.6/§6.5).

max_evidence_rounds.description: Bounded-loop budget: max REQUEST_EVIDENCE rounds per decision (§5.6/§10.1).

max_reviewer_risk.description: The calibrated upper_risk_bound threshold: the reviewer is granted blocking authority only when its cohort DecisionEnvelope.calibration.upper_risk_bound <= this value (§8 step 5 / §11.4). Absent = reviewer never authorized to block (advisory only).

calibration_cohort.description: The cohort key under which reviewer risk is measured for this profile (spec §6.5/§11.2). Decisions are never pooled across materially different conditions.
